title: Assignment map
description: The structured view of one assignment that every assignment-coach mode consumes (spec §4.3). Produced once after the scan and the course context, validated with scripts/validate_map.py, then reused by breakdown, guide, check and solve.

course.description: Course name as the university calls it

family.description: Discipline family; one of the 12 packs in references/disciplines/

title.description: Short name of the assignment (HW3, Seminar paper, Lab 2)

questions.description: Every discrete part of the assignment, in the order it appears

estimate_hours.description: Expected effort in hours; used by scripts/split_work.py for group work

depends_on_interface.description: Ids of questions whose interface (signature, data format) this one is built against; the finished part is not needed

depends_on.description: Ids of questions whose result this one needs; every id must exist in `questions`

due.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) or null when unknown

ai_policy.description: Only the student or a visible, quotable source sets this; see references/ai-policy.md
